newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks volatile after U.S. growth data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks volatile after U.S. growth data.

text.p: French shares seesawed in the wake of U.S. fourth quarter growth data, dealers said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index initially fell 0.39 percent as U.S. data showed a 4.7 percent rise in U.S. fourth quarter Gross Domestic Product. The market had expected 3.9 percent growth.
But the market took heart from a weaker than expected rise in the U.S. deflator that eased inflation concern, they said.
The CAC-40 index was up 4.87 points or 0.19 percent at 2,507.93 at 1345 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up five points at 2,508.0
